headline: Airbyte says an attacker had access to its systems; how, who and what was reached are not established.
summary: First draft. 7 sources (2 Tier 1, 1 Tier 4, 4 Tier 3; no Tier 2 coverage found), 14 claims (7 Confirmed, 1 Reported, 6 Not established), 6 questions. Airbyte's status page and X posts say a security incident, a blocked attacker, Cloud taken offline and fewer than 1% of customers affected. Salesforce's own advisory says it disabled the Airbyte connected app on Nov 20 and that this was not a Salesforce platform problem. The 'broader, global cyberattack' is Airbyte's unexplained belief and stays Reported. Customer data, attacker and root cause are Not established. CyberSIXT blocked automated reading, so its content was read through search-result text. Airbyte's X posts were read through a third-party mirror. Privacy check done: no names of people, no handles, no contact details.
author: Editor-in-Chief
